annunciation-angelico.title: The Annunciation
annunciation-angelico.alt: The angel Gabriel kneels before Mary in a quiet cloister, both with halos, his colored wings folded, her hands crossed.
annunciation-angelico.credit: Convent of San Marco, Florence. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

annunciation-martini.title: The Annunciation
annunciation-martini.alt: Gabriel kneels on a gold ground and speaks to Mary, who draws back, a vase of lilies between them.
annunciation-martini.credit: Gallerie degli Uffizi, Florence. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

immaculate-murillo.title: The Immaculate Conception of the Venerables
immaculate-murillo.alt: Mary stands on a cloud in a white gown and blue mantle, hands crossed, cherubs gathered around her.
immaculate-murillo.credit: Museo del Prado, Madrid. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

guadalupe.title: The Virgin of Guadalupe
guadalupe.alt: Our Lady of Guadalupe, crowned, hands joined, standing on a crescent held by an angel, rays of shell inlay around her.
guadalupe.credit: Enconchado, Museo Franz Mayer, Mexico City. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

nativity-giotto.title: The Nativity
nativity-giotto.alt: Mary lies under a wooden shelter beside the child, angels above, Joseph seated in front, shepherds and sheep to the right.
nativity-giotto.credit: Cappella degli Scrovegni, Padua. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

holy-family-murillo.title: The Holy Family with the Little Bird
holy-family-murillo.alt: The child Jesus stands between Mary, who holds a spindle, and Joseph, a small white dog at their feet.
holy-family-murillo.credit: Museo del Prado, Madrid. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

madonna-duccio.title: Madonna and Child
madonna-duccio.alt: Mary in a deep blue mantle holds the child, who reaches up to touch her face, on a worn gold ground.
madonna-duccio.credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

magi-gentile.title: Adoration of the Magi
magi-gentile.alt: The three kings and their retinue approach Mary and the child, horses and attendants crowded into a gold landscape.
magi-gentile.credit: Gallerie degli Uffizi, Florence. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

baptism-giotto.title: The Baptism of Christ
baptism-giotto.alt: Christ stands in the Jordan while John baptizes him and angels wait on the bank.
baptism-giotto.credit: Cappella degli Scrovegni, Padua. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

presentation-lord-giotto.title: The Presentation of Christ in the Temple
presentation-lord-giotto.alt: Mary hands the child to Simeon at the temple altar, Joseph and a prophetess beside them.
presentation-lord-giotto.credit: Cappella degli Scrovegni, Padua. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

presentation-mary-giotto.title: The Presentation of the Virgin
presentation-mary-giotto.alt: The young Mary climbs the temple steps toward the priest, her parents and onlookers below.
presentation-mary-giotto.credit: Cappella degli Scrovegni, Padua. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

joseph-latour.title: Saint Joseph the Carpenter
joseph-latour.alt: Joseph bends over his work by candlelight while the child Jesus holds the light.
joseph-latour.credit: Musée du Louvre, Paris. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

wilderness-kramskoi.title: Christ in the Wilderness
wilderness-kramskoi.alt: Christ sits alone on a stone in a barren landscape, hands clasped, at the beginning of the forty days.
wilderness-kramskoi.credit: Tretyakov Gallery, Moscow. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

transfiguration-raphael.title: The Transfiguration
transfiguration-raphael.alt: Christ is lifted in light between Moses and Elijah, while the apostles below struggle with a possessed boy.
transfiguration-raphael.credit: Pinacoteca Vaticana. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

entry-giotto.title: Entry into Jerusalem
entry-giotto.alt: Christ rides a donkey toward the city gate as people spread cloaks and cut branches.
entry-giotto.credit: Cappella degli Scrovegni, Padua. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

washing-giotto.title: The Washing of the Feet
washing-giotto.alt: Christ kneels and washes Peter's feet while the other apostles sit in a row.
washing-giotto.credit: Cappella degli Scrovegni, Padua. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

crucifix-velazquez.title: Christ Crucified
crucifix-velazquez.alt: Christ hangs on the cross against a dark ground, head fallen, a quiet and uncrowded crucifixion.
crucifix-velazquez.credit: Museo del Prado, Madrid. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

entombment-caravaggio.title: The Entombment of Christ
entombment-caravaggio.alt: Nicodemus and John lower Christ's body toward the stone, Mary and the Magdalene behind them.
entombment-caravaggio.credit: Pinacoteca Vaticana. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

resurrection-piero.title: The Resurrection
resurrection-piero.alt: Christ steps from the tomb with a banner, four soldiers asleep at his feet, trees behind him.
resurrection-piero.credit: Museo Civico, Sansepolcro. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

thomas-caravaggio.title: The Incredulity of Saint Thomas
thomas-caravaggio.alt: Thomas leans in and touches the wound in Christ's side, two apostles crowded close.
thomas-caravaggio.credit: Sanssouci, Potsdam. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

emmaus-caravaggio.title: Supper at Emmaus
emmaus-caravaggio.alt: The risen Christ blesses the bread at table while the two disciples start back in recognition.
emmaus-caravaggio.credit: National Gallery, London. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

shepherd-murillo.title: The Good Shepherd
shepherd-murillo.alt: The child Christ sits with a shepherd's staff, one hand on a lamb, the flock in the distance.
shepherd-murillo.credit: Museo del Prado, Madrid. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

pentecost-greco.title: Pentecost
pentecost-greco.alt: Mary and the apostles look up as the dove appears and tongues of fire rest on them.
pentecost-greco.credit: Museo del Prado, Madrid. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

trinity-rublev.title: The Trinity
trinity-rublev.alt: Three angels sit at a table in quiet conversation, the icon of Abraham's hospitality read as the Trinity.
trinity-rublev.credit: Tretyakov Gallery, Moscow. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

last-supper-giotto.title: The Last Supper
last-supper-giotto.alt: Christ and the apostles sit at a long table, and Christ gives the bread.
last-supper-giotto.credit: Cappella degli Scrovegni, Padua. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

sacred-heart-batoni.title: The Sacred Heart of Jesus
sacred-heart-batoni.alt: Christ holds his heart, crowned with thorns and lit, and opens his other hand toward the viewer.

assumption-titian.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
assumption-titian.alt: Mary rises on a cloud toward the Father, apostles reaching up from below, in the great arched altarpiece.
assumption-titian.credit: Basilica di Santa Maria Gloriosa dei Frari, Venice. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

all-saints-durer.title: Adoration of the Trinity
all-saints-durer.alt: The Trinity is adored above a great company of saints, clergy, and people gathered in a landscape.
all-saints-durer.credit: Kunsthistorisches Museum, Vienna. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

all-souls-greco.title: The Burial of the Count of Orgaz
all-souls-greco.alt: Saints Stephen and Augustine lower a nobleman into the grave while heaven opens above the funeral.
all-souls-greco.credit: Iglesia de Santo Tomé, Toledo. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

last-judgment-angelico.title: The Last Judgment
last-judgment-angelico.alt: Christ in glory judges the living and the dead, saints ranked above and the blessed and the lost below.
last-judgment-angelico.credit: Gemäldegalerie, Berlin. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

advent-blake.title: The Parable of the Wise and Foolish Virgins
advent-blake.alt: An angel sounds a trumpet above the wise virgins with their lamps, while the foolish ones plead at the door.

baptist-greco.title: Saint John the Baptist
baptist-greco.alt: John stands nearly nude in a rocky landscape, a camel skin over one shoulder, a tall reed cross in his hand, and a lamb asleep on a stone.

peter-paul-greco.title: Saint Peter and Saint Paul
peter-paul-greco.alt: Peter and Paul stand together, Peter with the keys, the two heads turned toward one another.
peter-paul-greco.credit: State Hermitage Museum, Saint Petersburg. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

conversion-caravaggio.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
conversion-caravaggio.alt: Paul lies on his back in the stable while a horse fills the darkness and the light strikes him.
conversion-caravaggio.credit: Santa Maria del Popolo, Rome. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

matthew-caravaggio.title: The Calling of Saint Matthew
matthew-caravaggio.alt: Christ points through a shaft of light at Matthew, seated with coins at a table of tax collectors.
matthew-caravaggio.credit: San Luigi dei Francesi, Rome. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

michael-raphael.title: Saint Michael Vanquishing Satan
michael-raphael.alt: Michael stands winged and armored, spear planted, over the fallen enemy.
michael-raphael.credit: Musée du Louvre, Paris. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

visitation-giotto.title: The Visitation
visitation-giotto.alt: Mary and Elizabeth embrace at a doorway, both with halos.
visitation-giotto.credit: Cappella degli Scrovegni, Padua. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

innocents-giotto.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
innocents-giotto.alt: Soldiers seize children while mothers reach for them, in Giotto's compact fresco.
innocents-giotto.credit: Cappella degli Scrovegni, Padua. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

temple-giotto.title: Expulsion of the Money-changers
temple-giotto.alt: Christ drives the sellers from the temple, arm raised, tables and figures giving way.
temple-giotto.credit: Cappella degli Scrovegni, Padua. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

carrying-greco.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
carrying-greco.alt: Christ embraces the cross, eyes lifted, the wood filling the frame.
carrying-greco.credit: Public domain. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

dream-champaigne.title: The Dream of Saint Joseph
dream-champaigne.alt: An angel appears to the sleeping Joseph and points toward Mary, who waits in prayer.
dream-champaigne.credit: National Gallery, London. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

sermon-angelico.title: The Sermon on the Mount
sermon-angelico.alt: Christ sits teaching on the hillside, the apostles gathered close in a spare landscape.
sermon-angelico.credit: Convent of San Marco, Florence. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

storm-rembrandt.title: Christ in the Storm on the Sea of Galilee
storm-rembrandt.alt: A fishing boat heels in a black wave while the disciples strain at the sail and Christ is among them.
storm-rembrandt.credit: Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum, Boston. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

teaching-tissot.title: Jesus Teaching on the Sea Shore
teaching-tissot.alt: Christ sits on a rock by the water and teaches a crowd in pale robes, hills and palms behind them.
teaching-tissot.credit: Brooklyn Museum, New York. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

sassoferrato.title: The Virgin in Prayer
sassoferrato.alt: Mary is shown in quiet prayer, hands joined, veil and blue mantle against a dark ground.
sassoferrato.credit: Nationalmuseum, Stockholm. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

francis-giotto.title: Saint Francis Receiving the Stigmata
francis-giotto.alt: Francis kneels on a rocky slope as the seraphim marks his hands, feet, and side.
francis-giotto.credit: Musée du Louvre, Paris. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

pantocrator.title: Christ Pantocrator
pantocrator.alt: Christ faces outward, one hand raised in blessing, the other holding a jeweled book, a gold halo behind him.
pantocrator.credit: Monastery of Saint Catherine, Sinai. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

jesse-tree.title: The Tree of Jesse
jesse-tree.alt: A tree rises from Jesse through rows of ancestors to Mary and the child at the crown of the page.
jesse-tree.credit: Walters Art Museum, Baltimore, manuscript W.543. CC0.

birth-john.title: The Birth and Naming of Saint John the Baptist
birth-john.alt: Women bathe and wrap the infant John while Zechariah writes the name, a peacock in the courtyard.
birth-john.credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

serpent-rubens.title: Moses and the Brazen Serpent
serpent-rubens.alt: Moses lifts the bronze serpent while the people reach toward it, bodies tangled below.
serpent-rubens.credit: National Gallery, London. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

lamentation-giotto.title: The Lamentation
lamentation-giotto.alt: Mary holds her son at the foot of the cross while angels tear the sky and the mourners bend close.
lamentation-giotto.credit: Cappella degli Scrovegni, Padua. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

flight-giotto.title: The Flight into Egypt
flight-giotto.alt: Mary rides with the child while Joseph leads them across a bare hillside.
flight-giotto.credit: Cappella degli Scrovegni, Padua. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

ascension-giotto.title: The Ascension
ascension-giotto.alt: Christ rises in a mandorla while the apostles and Mary look up from the hillside.
ascension-giotto.credit: Cappella degli Scrovegni, Padua. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

prodigal-rembrandt.title: The Return of the Prodigal Son
prodigal-rembrandt.alt: The father bends and lays both hands on the kneeling son, the household watching from the shadow.
prodigal-rembrandt.credit: State Hermitage Museum, Saint Petersburg. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

noli-titian.title: Noli Me Tangere
noli-titian.alt: The risen Christ, with a hoe, draws back from Mary Magdalene as she reaches toward him in a landscape.
noli-titian.credit: National Gallery, London. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
